protected_numbering.ICF-07: Creature Harvest, Butchery & Biological Ingredient System
protected_numbering.rule: ICF-06 remains the originally approved magical/exotic tranche. Creature harvesting remains ICF-07. Newly approved creature part/effect grammar and catalog crosswalk are ICF-08 and ICF-09; former ICF-08 through ICF-13 shift to ICF-10 through ICF-15.

creature_effect_inheritance: part baseline -> body-plan/creature-type profile -> creature affinity/trait profile -> explicit species/variant override -> harvested-instance quality/condition
integration_requirements: long-running and repeated ICF work reuses existing Downtime/Project activity semantics
ICF may declare Cozy automation eligibility metadata but never grant automation authority
bounded Cozy execution must retain explicit time inputs outputs budgets versions ownership and stop conditions
wall-clock elapsed time is not game progress by default
boundaries: one canonical ingredient definition may serve culinary magical-culinary alchemical agricultural trade ritual medicine and crafting profiles
creature harvest references canonical creature and output definitions rather than creating a parallel loot ledger
generic part/type affinities do not authorize invented anatomy or lore
harvestability does not imply edibility legality cultural acceptability or safety
live outputs remain owner-domain Asset/inventory instances
source provenance and terminology remain traceable
no second Downtime/Project or Cozy scheduler/authority layer
